text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service -
AUSTRALIA, Feb 24 - COAL - QUEENSLAND - Abbot Point - Berth vacant, 4 vessels due by 12/3, no delays.
Dalrymple Bay - One vessel loading, 14 due by 10/3, no delays.
Hay point - One vessel loading, 10 due by 21/3, no delays.
Gladstone - R.G. Tanna - 1 Vessel loading, 23 due by 5/4, no delays.
Barney Point - Berth vacant, 4 vessels due by 15/3, no delays.
Brisbane - Berth vacant, 5 vessels due by 10,3, no delays.
NEW SOUTH WALES - Newcastle - MUA members of pilot cutter on 24 hour strike from 14.00 hrs. 24/2. All traffic movements have been affected.
Kooragang - 2 Vessels loading, 2 waiting, 19 due by 7/3, approx. 2-3 days delay expected.
Channel (Dyke) - 2 Vessels loading, 4 waiting, 14 due by 8/3, approx. 3-4 days delay expected.
Port Kembla - Berth vacant, 13 vessels due by 20/4, no delays.

IRON ORE - SOUTH AUSTRALIA - Port Hedland - Mt. Newman (Nelson Point) - Shippers advise that due to current shortages of Mt. Newman fines and Yandi fines, iron ore vessels may experience some delay to berthing/loading or be forced to berth out of turn. A berth - 1 Vessel loading, 3 anchored, 6 due by 5/3. B berth - 1 Vessel loading, 5 anchored, 7 due by 4/3, 3 other vessels due by 13/3, no eta received.
Goldsworthy (Finucane island) - 1 Vessel loading, 2 due by 25/2, 1 due 8/3, no eta received.
Dampier - Parker Point - 1 Vessel loading, 1 anchored, 3 due by 25/2.
East Intercourse island - 1 Vessel loading, 4 anchored.

Dampier line-up - 16 Vessels due by 13/3 of which 8 for Parker Point, 7 for East Intercourse island. Dredging operations to be carried out at Parker Point and East Intercourse island from 1-5 March which will cause some further berthing delays. Parker Point maintenance shutdown for 24 hours from 11.00 hrs. 25/2.
Port Walcott - Reopened for operations 22/2. One vessel loading, 1 berthed, 2 anchored, 10 due by 15/3.
GRAIN - QUEENSLAND - Mackay - No vessels due. Grain shipments expected to commence late-April.
Gladstone - No vessels due.
Brisbane - One vessel loading wheat, 1 waiting to load wheat, 3 due by 10/3, all to load wheat.
NEW SOUTH WALES - Newcastle - One vessel loading wheat, 1 waiting to load wheat, 6 due by 6/3 of which 5 to load wheat, 1 barley.
Port Kembla - One vessel loading wheat, 4 waiting of which 3 to load wheat, 1 barley. 5 Vessels due by 15/3, all to load wheat.
VICTORIA - Geelong - Two vessels waiting to load barley, 4 due by 23/2 of which 2 to load wheat, 1 canola, 1 barley.
Portland - One vessel loading peas, 13 due by 16/3 of which 7 to load wheat, 2 barley, 2 beans, 2 peas.
SOUTH AUSTRALIA - Port Pirie - One vessel loading wheat, 1 due 30/3 to load wheat.
Port Adelaide - One vessel loading malt, 2 waiting to load of which 1 malt, 1 wheat, 4 due by 3/4, all to load wheat.
Thevenard - Five vessels due by 16/3, all to load wheat.
Port Lincoln - One vessel waiting to load wheat, 13 due by 23/3 of which 12 to load wheat, 1 lupins.
Wallaroo - One vessel loading wheat, 3 waiting to load wheat.
Ardrossan - No vessels due.
Port Giles - Four vessels due by 19/3, all to load wheat.
WESTERN AUSTRALIA - Geraldton - One vessel loading canola, 10 due by 16/3 of which 1 to load lupins, 1 barley, 8 wheat. Jetty repairs to be completed by 26/2.
Kwinana - Two vessels loading wheat, 2 waiting to load wheat, 16 due by 19/3 of which 4 to load barley, 2 lupins, 10 wheat.
Albany - One vessel loading wheat, 4 waiting to load of which 1 barley, 3 wheat. 4 Vessels due by 10/3, all to load wheat.
Esperance - One vessel loading wheat, 2 due by 18/3 of which 1 to load lupins, 1 barley.
